text_blocks.snippet: Firstcard is a secured credit builder card designed to help people build or rebuild their credit. It's different from a traditional credit card because it's secured by a cash deposit, and it doesn't extend a credit line beyond the deposit amount. This approach encourages responsible spending and helps users avoid overspending and high interest rates.

list.title: Secured Credit Card:
list.snippet: Firstcard requires a cash deposit, which determines your spending limit, unlike traditional credit cards.

list.title: Credit Building:
list.snippet: Using Firstcard responsibly, by making timely payments, can help you build or rebuild your credit score as your positive payment activity is reported to all three major credit bureaus (Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion).

list.title: No Credit Check:
list.snippet: Firstcard offers an easy application process and doesn't require a hard credit check, making it accessible to those with limited or no credit history, like beginners or those rebuilding their credit.

list.title: No Interest Charges:
list.snippet: Firstcard doesn't have interest charges, which is different from traditional credit cards that can accrue interest on unpaid balances.

list.title: No Hidden Fees:
list.snippet: Firstcard is transparent about fees, and it doesn't have annual fees, overdraft fees, or late fees.

list.title: Spending Limit:
list.snippet: You can only spend what you deposit, eliminating the risk of overspending or high credit utilization ratios, which are common with traditional credit cards.

list.title: 0% APR:
list.snippet: Firstcard offers a 0% APR, meaning you won't accrue interest on your balance, making it a safer option for building credit.

list.title: Credit Monitoring:
list.snippet: Firstcard offers in-app credit monitoring to help you track your progress and stay on top of your credit building journey.

list.title: Cashback Rewards:
list.snippet: Firstcard offers cashback rewards at select merchants.

list.title: Safe and Secure:
list.snippet: Firstcard uses industry-standard encryption technology and is insured by a partner bank.

list.title: Powered by Mastercard:
list.snippet: Firstcard is powered by Mastercard and includes Zero Liability Fraud Protection.
